description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/AltF4G0x/consumer-clarity/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* Add runtime settings and external link controls ([fd71efe](https://github.com/AltF4G0x/consumer-clarity/commit/fd71efe15f22ad92a612bbd85322ad52eea2ddf7))

patches.name: Consistent restaurant and review sorting
patches.description: Sorts restaurants by organic placement, rating and ID, and reviews by date and ID. Requires Talabat 14.4.0 (2368) on ARM64.

patches.name: Disable Play license gate
patches.description: Skips the pairip license check and its repeated scheduler so the modified app can start without Google Play licensing. Other Google-dependent features are unchanged.

patches.name: Hide Braze in-app popups
patches.description: Prevents Braze promotional in-app messages from being queued or displayed. Functional app dialogs and push notifications are unchanged.

patches.name: Open links in default browser
patches.description: Routes links that would open in Talabat's in-app WebView to the default browser. Can be toggled in Consumer Clarity settings.

patches.name: Reduce analytics tracking
patches.description: Disables confirmed Firebase, Adjust, Perseus and Braze event logging paths without blocking restaurant, checkout or order-tracking network requests.
